producer_note: Built with the CI runtime pin. The published v0.1.0 release rejects dict literals with mixed value types, so a source build at the pin is the producer; tests/test_tui_howlframe_engine.py rebuilds with the pinned compiler and compares bytes. Earlier builds used e64256e, dffcb00, 928c005 and, before that, 41d56ce; the ADR 0009 reducer artifact was retired with the Python host. hfbc_format is the format the artifact header carries; earlier records said 1 while the header said 2.
